function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT pl.period, AVG(pl.fx_rate) AS avg_fx_rate FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl WHERE pl.currency = 'USD' AND pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY pl.period","purpose":"Get average fx_rate for USD purchase lines in Aug and Sep 2026"}
